text_block_list.text:
Invited by Ms. Tazuna, I came along today 
for a rather belated first shrine visit of 
the year.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
My... even though the New Year 
celebrations are over, there are still so 
many people here~!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Speaking of midwinter excitement, it 
reminds me of last year's Arima Kinen.
choice_data_list: It was certainly bustling with people.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The ultimate year-end showdown that 
concludes the autumn GⅠ series—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to the Arima Kinen, I 
imagine it's a special race for many 
Umamusume, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
A stage reserved only for the chosen girls 
who achieved great feats that year and 
captured the hearts of countless fans...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
No matter the era, there are always many 
girls who dream of standing on the turf of 
year-end Nakayama.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...My racing itch is acting up! It's a bit 
far, but why don't we go take a peek? At 
Nakayama Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu. New Year's shrine visits are 
lovely, but the excitement of the 
racetrack is something truly special!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
There are people who come out like this 
today too, just to see the Umamusume run—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san. Please continue to support 
the Umamusume in your charge, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I will... continue to have high 
expectations for you!

...Somehow, I felt like Tazuna-san and I 
would be able to grow even closer from now 
on.
